title: derived-from
description: A standard STIX derived-from relationship as the catalog uses it: a CAIQ question derived from the control it assesses. Read left to right — source_ref is the derived object. This adds no custom properties, so derived-from needs no extension declaration; the schema exists only to catch mistargeted references in catalog data, and makes no claim about how derived-from may be used elsewhere.

source_ref.description: The derived object — a CAIQ question, itself an x-control in a caiq framework.

target_ref.description: What it was derived from — the control the question assesses.
